alt:|Best Shot of Lewes, Delaware endorses Dan Zitofsky. Owner Ron Hagan: Best Shot is proud to endorse Dan Zitofsky. We know Dan will work to protect our Second Amendment rights when others continue to trample on them.

alt:|DSSA, the Delaware State Sportsman's Association, endorses Dan Zitofsky for 4th District State Representative. Quote from Jeff Hague, President, DSSA: Dan Zitofsky is the candidate of choice in the 4th District. He understands the importance of protecting our Second Amendment rights and will be a strong voice for sportsmen, hunters and all law abiding citizens of Delaware.

alt:|Endorsed by State Representative Dr. Jeff Hilovsky, 4th District, Delaware. Quote: Dan has what it takes to represent all. I personally endorse him for the next 4th District State Representative as my replacement.

alt:|Endorsed by the Correctional Officers Association of Delaware (COAD). Quote: This endorsement means a great deal to me. As a former police officer and someone who has supported first responders my entire life, standing with the men and women who keep our communities safe is personal. My vote will never belong to special interests. It belongs to the people of the 4th District.
